checks.description: Host tests demonstrate discovery under the exact eMMC controller for a target with a non-assumed Linux mmcN number, ignore an unrelated small SD, and reject multiple matching MMC cards.
Beelink succeeds with default NFSv3/TCP mountd port discovery without explicit mountport and confirms export write refusal.
Warnings-as-errors init build, refreshed exact-hash NFS manifest/composition evidence, and separate high-consequence review before another physical boot.
Record the first supervised attempt as NFS failure before probe execution, preserve private trace hash, and leave current eMMC boot counters unknown.

constraints.text: Search only beneath the exact 4022000.mmc controller, retain unique nominal-32GB MMC selection and read-only fixed-offset access, and fail closed on ambiguity. Passing fixture tests does not establish physical eMMC initialization.

Verify default NFSv3/TCP mountd discovery, read-only refusal, and the expected printer-address export. Record how mountd registration is maintained for the proposed retry; persistent Beelink configuration changes require separate scope review.

Record the first boot as an NFS failure before probe execution, with current counters unknown. Before another physical boot, obtain a separate GPT-6 Sol high-consequence review of exact deployed hashes, NFS state, MMC initialization evidence, and single-boot stop conditions.

decision.rationale: The correction addresses the measured NFS refusal and the probe's unstable mmc2 assumption within the approved disposable diagnostic. The physical trace contains no probe result and shows a non-removable MMC initialization failure, so eMMC visibility and current counters remain unknown. The existing approved proposal excludes persistent Beelink configuration changes and hardware writes.

evidence.limitations: Synthetic sysfs fixture and QEMU do not establish physical eMMC initialization.
evidence.method: Ran `python3 -m unittest tests.test_sd_network_env_probe tests.test_sd_network_image -v`; the locator fixture accepts the 32 GB MMC under mmc0, ignores small SD under mmc2, and rejects a second qualifying MMC.

evidence.limitations: The local mount originated from Beelink, not the printer address. Printer-side NFS mount is not yet measured; mountd registration is manually restarted and not persistent.
evidence.method: On Beelink 192.168.1.136, mountd v3/TCP was registered at port 20048; a default NFSv3/TCP mount without mountport fetched the deployed init hash, and a write attempt returned Read-only file system. The export table contains 192.168.1.141 with ro/root_squash.

evidence.limitations: High-consequence review is not hardware authorization and does not prove the next physical boot will reach eMMC. No physical retry has occurred.
evidence.method: Static ARM64 init built with -Wall -Wextra -Werror; corrected source, binary and manifest hashes are recorded. Exact binary hash matches the live Beelink export. QEMU NFS online and missing-server cases passed; separate GPT-6 Sol high-consequence review returned PASS WITH CONDITIONS for exactly one supervised retry.

evidence.limitations: Raw serial evidence remains private on Beelink; no eMMC contents or counters were read in this attempt.
evidence.method: Recorded the 2026-09-26 receive-only trace hash and exact measured boot result: DHCP succeeded, NFS root was refused, no probe marker occurred, mmc0 failed non-removable card initialization, mmc2 was SD, and eMMC counters remain unknown.

tasks.title: Correct probe host discovery and NFS evidence

verification.rationale: Reviewed the complete a94c86a..2b51bbf diff and clean implementation worktree. All four acceptance checks are supported: 10 focused tests reproduced successfully; the locator is restricted to controller 4022000, accepts a uniquely sized MMC regardless of host number, and rejects ambiguity; the corrected executable and manifest hashes match the composition receipt; and the record accurately states that the physical attempt stopped before the probe. The Beelink NFS test originated locally, and physical eMMC initialization and current counters remain unverified. The separate supervised retry conditions remain mandatory.
